policy: Frozen before backend execution; all elementwise AND NRMSE gates must pass; nonfinite always fails; no post-failure relaxation.

cumulative.argmax: lowest token ID on exact tie; require equal argmax when reference top-two margin > 2*max_abs_error; record all other flips

quantization_quality.comparison: same adapted FP32 release, tokenizer, protocol, split, input and generation settings; percentage point differences, not relative percent
quantization_quality.heldout_policy: never use v2 heldout for calibration, tuning or model selection; freeze before a final quality evaluation
quantization_quality.operator_quantization_error: report against original FP32 separately; arithmetic tolerance is only candidate versus identical quantized reference
